verdict.rationale: The CLI is documented to 'script repeatable tasks' and 'wire Airwallex into automated systems,' and AgentOS supports 'multi-step financial workflows,' which could be used to loop through many items programmatically, but there is no explicit documentation of a native bulk/batch API (e.g., bulk payouts, batch beneficiary creation, CSV mass-upload) for processing many items in a single call. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch API endpoints, documented bulk transfer/payout mechanism, evidence of processing many items in one request rather than scripted iteration.
